issues.failure_explanation: The proof must place \hat{E} as a closed subspace of L_1 to invoke Theorem theorem:Lpembed, but: (i) an RKBS need not be closed in \ell_\infty(\Omega) - continuous point evaluations (even with compact embedding, as in C^1[0,1] with the C^1 norm, which is a compactly embedded RKBS in \ell_\infty) do not imply sup-norm closedness (C^1[0,1] is dense, hence not closed, in C^0 \subset \ell_\infty); (ii) \ell_\infty(\Omega) as defined (all bounded functions) does not embed into L_1(\nu) without measurability; (iii) even a continuous inclusion into L_1 does not make the image closed. Hence the hypothesis of Theorem theorem:Lpembed ('closed subspace of L_1') is neither verified nor true in general, and the isomorphism to a subspace of L_{s'}(\mu) - the step that produces the feature map and the embedding E \hookrightarrow \mathcal{B}_s - is unestablished.
